content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(MP-029 Archive-extracted executable runs beside a zero-byte pic1.png decoy) AND BIOC(MP-029 Diaoyu security-product process-name discovery) AND (BIOC(MP-029 Image-named payload staged into a lure execution directory) OR IOC(domain in abwxjp5.me, msonline.help, servgate.me, zamstats.me)) AND (IOC(file-sha256 in the report lure/Cobalt Strike hashes on panw_ngfw_threat_raw) OR ABIOC(MP-029 Recurring beacon to a rare TGR-STA-1030 C2 domain) OR ABIOC(MP-029 Rare process SSH session to a leased relay VPS)) within 3600s on the same endpoint entity (xdr_data agent_hostname = panw_ngfw_*_raw endpoint_device_name, src_ip reconciled by XDM endpoint resolution) -> ONE TGR-STA-1030 incident enriched with the Unit 42 indicators; ShadowGuard BIOCs join when they fire on the same host.
rules.name: TGR-STA-1030 Shadow Campaigns — Diaoyu lure to C2 and relay, stitched on src_host
